# Third-party code

- `rife_ifnet_v4_25.py`, `rife_warplayer.py` — RIFE v4.25 IFNet architecture, copied from
  [vs-rife](https://github.com/HolyWu/vs-rife) 5.7.0 (MIT, see `LICENSE-vs-rife.txt`), which ports
  [Practical-RIFE](https://github.com/hzwer/Practical-RIFE) by hzwer (MIT). Only the relative import was changed.
